title: Sustainable synthesis of hydroxyapatite-containing composites from eggshells for soil amendment applications
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,262-268
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00577A, Paper

Letizia Castellini, Alessia Giordana, Mery Malandrino, Lorenza Operti, Giuseppina Cerrato
Hydroxyapatite was synthesized from eggshell, after dissolution in ascorbic acid, a green, non-toxic reagent. Avoiding thermal treatment permits enhancement of energy efficiency.
